modalLead: The video mark moves onto the icon, the theme browser's Light and Dark filters show what they say, and the theme settings and help are translated into every language.

items.text: The ▶ sits on the icon. A video's mark was a chip after the name, beside the response time and the shortcut. It is now a small disc on the corner of the favicon, so the row keeps its width. With favicons off it stands beside the name, without a box.
Light and Dark show every theme in that half. In the theme browser, the two filters now turn every card to its light or dark half, so moving through the grid previews only light or only dark themes.
Theme settings in your language. The characters, Effects and the other surface settings, and the help about them, are translated into Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Chinese.
